translations.name: KANSASWORKS
translations.description: KANSASWORKS is a free job website. You can search for jobs, build a resume, find job fairs, and look for training programs. You can also get one-on-one help at a Workforce Center near you. Some training programs have their own rules. Call 877-509-6757 to find your nearest center.
translations.website_description: Find jobs, training, job fairs, and Workforce Center help.
